renderings.value: Sadako's friends wanted to build a monument to her and all children who were killed by the atomic bomb.
The whole world could be destroyed by an atomic war.
The atomic bomb is a grave threat to mankind.
The atomic bomb destroyed the entire city of Hiroshima.
Toshiko Tanaka is a survivor of the Hiroshima bombing turned advocate for peace and nuclear disarmament.
